entry.title: Resolution 617 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): GOEAC-154: Recommended adoption - 08/04/26
entry.content:
APPROVES THE NOMINATIONS MADE BY THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE HAWAIʻI STATE ASSOCIATION OF COUNTIES FOR THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF COUNTIES (NACo) BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND THE WESTERN INTERSTATE REGION (WIR) BOARD OF DIRECTORS

Requests the Council’s approval of the following slates of officers: NACo – KipuKai Kualiʻi, Kauaʻi County and Tommy Waters, City and County of Honolulu
